params.prompt: Japanese byōbu six-panel folding screen painting, Edo period Rinpa / Kanō style: three red-crowned cranes — one standing on a rocky shore, two in graceful flight — beside an old pine tree with twisting branches and clusters of needles, mineral pigment and sumi ink on a gold-leaf ground with drifting gold cloud bands, aged washi texture, faint vertical panel hinge lines; a vertical calligraphy column of four kanji and a small red square seal in the upper right corner; wide panoramic composition, museum photograph of the artwork, even soft lighting, no frame, no border, no watermark
